# Veyvox 1.17.2

## Standalone native accounts

- Removed federation, peer connections, linked-account credentials, relay workers,
  remote policies and their settings/translations. One selected server, one native
  account and the existing API/WebSocket now serve all application features.
- Native accounts (including retained legacy handles), messages, uploads, spaces,
  bot permissions, DM history/visibility and Juno progression are preserved.
  Old peer credentials are retired without clearing native drafts or transfers.
- RNNoise and hang-up controls have an 8px gap and matching 8px corner radii.

## Security

- Enforced native upload ownership and shared-asset retention across profile,
  space, group-DM and bot edits and deletion.
- Pinned preview connections to validated public DNS answers, with bounded
  redirects, decompression, body sizes and request lifetimes.
- Hardened signed session claims, same-second password revocation and open-socket
  disconnects, including login/password-change races with a concurrent reset;
  isolated pending work and transfers across account/server changes.
- Restricted desktop server replacement to the trusted bundled picker and live
  main frame; unsafe or credential-bearing destinations are refused.
- Preserved upload auto-resume after native authentication and batched janitor
  reference checks to avoid rescanning every attachment for each deleted file.

## Upgrade notice

**Back up the database and uploads before upgrading.** Startup snapshots the
database before generated migrations 0049/0050. They permanently remove
federation-only records and obsolete columns; there is no compatibility mode.
Ambiguous native ownership stops the upgrade instead of guessing or wiping data.
To roll back, stop the application and restore the matching pre-upgrade backup;
do not run an older server against the migrated database.

Desktop signing/platform limitations remain those documented for 1.17.0. No
production deployment is performed by this release preparation.

## Português (Brasil)

A federação foi removida por completo. O aplicativo usa um servidor selecionado
e uma conta nativa, preservando contas, mensagens, arquivos, espaços, bots, DMs
e progresso do Juno. Os controles RNNoise/encerrar ficaram mais espaçados e com
arredondamento uniforme. Foram reforçadas as verificações de arquivos, sessões,
pré-visualizações de links e navegação do desktop.

**Faça backup do banco e dos uploads antes de atualizar.** As migrações removem
permanentemente os dados exclusivos da federação; para voltar à versão anterior,
restaure o backup correspondente com o aplicativo parado.
